name: @skaly/shared
scriptsComment: typecheck runs build on purpose. apps/* consume this package through dist/*.d.ts (see exports), so a --noEmit typecheck here would leave a stale dist in place and every downstream typecheck would validate against outdated types. That is not hypothetical: it hid five sql<Date> errors until CI, which installs clean, caught them. Emitting here keeps pnpm -r typecheck honest, since pnpm runs it topologically before the apps.
